title: Rav Natan bar Minyumi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Shabbat 21b, Rav Kahana says that Rav Natan bar Minyumi expounded in Rabbi Tanchum’s name: a Chanukah lamp placed above twenty cubits is invalid. He likewise expounds in his name there, “The pit was empty”—but it contained snakes and scorpions. Dikdukei Soferim reports the Rosh’s reading that he spoke in Rav’s name.

notes.text: The Rosh’s reported reading names Rav instead of Tanchum. The pit quotation is a partial quotation, as in the supplied notice.

In the consulted Gemara the attribution begins at the end of 21b and the teaching continues on 22a. The consulted Rosh prints Rav with Tanchum in brackets. The reading without Tanchum is Hyman’s report from Dikdukei Soferim.
